es.name: Mote con huesillo
es.blurb: La bebida de verano chilena: duraznos secos en su almíbar de chancaca con mote de trigo. Se come y se toma.
steps: Cuece los huesillos con su agua de remojo, el agua, la chancaca, la canela y la naranja 40 minutos a fuego bajo.
Sirve en vasos altos: 2 cucharadas de mote, 2 huesillos y el jugo frío hasta arriba.
tips: Se sirve con cuchara larga para el mote.

en.name: Mote con Huesillo (Peach and Wheat Drink)
en.blurb: Chile's summer drink: dried peaches in their chancaca syrup with husked wheat. You eat and drink it.
steps: Cook the dried peaches with their soaking water, the water, chancaca, cinnamon and orange peel for 40 minutes on low.
Serve in tall glasses: 2 tablespoons of wheat, 2 peaches and the cold syrup to the top.
tips: Serve with a long spoon for the wheat.
